item.name: 👑 Super Admin
item.description: Super admin endpoints for dashboard, user management, admin management, and inquiries.

request.description: Update user role, status, or name. Send only the fields you want to change. Valid roles: SUPER_ADMIN | ADMIN | STAFF | USER | SUPPLIER. Valid statuses: ACTIVE | INACTIVE | PENDING | SUSPENDED. Do NOT include role/status when only changing password.

Change a user password as Super Admin. Send ONLY the password field — do not include role or status in this request. Password must be 8+ chars with uppercase, lowercase, number and special character. Make sure user_id env variable is set to the target user (NOT your own superadmin ID).

response.name: 400 - Weak Password
400 - Common Password Rejected
403 - Super Admin Protected

item.name: 💳 Payments
item.description: Payment processing, manual payments, refunds, and EPG online payments.

body.raw:
{
  "customerName": "John Smith",
  "customerEmail": "john@example.com",
  "customerPhone": "+966501234567",
  "customerAddress": "123 King Street, Riyadh",
  "companyName": "Smith Trading Co.",
  "expiryDate": "2025-12-31T00:00:00.000Z",
  "discount": 0,
  "taxRate": 15,
  "notes": "Bulk order discount applied",
  "terms": "Payment due within 30 days of invoice.",
  "items": [
    {
      "productId": "{{product_id}}",
      "quantity": 50,
      "discount": 5
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Create a new quotation as Admin. Required: customerName, customerEmail, expiryDate (must be future ISO date), items (min 1). Item fields: productId (UUID), quantity (1-10000), discount (0-100, default 0). Overall discount and taxRate are 0-100 percentages.

body.raw:
{
  "customerName": "John Smith",
  "customerEmail": "john.updated@example.com",
  "customerPhone": "+966501234567",
  "customerAddress": "456 New Street, Jeddah",
  "companyName": "Smith Trading Co.",
  "expiryDate": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "discount": 10,
  "taxRate": 15,
  "notes": "Updated terms — 10% overall discount applied.",
  "terms": "Payment due within 15 days.",
  "items": [
    {
      "productId": "{{product_id}}",
      "quantity": 60,
      "discount": 5
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Update quotation. At least one field required. expiryDate must be a future ISO date if provided. Item discount is per-item percentage (0-100). Overall discount is applied on subtotal.
Reactivate an expired quotation with a new future expiry date. Field name is expiryDate (not expiresAt).
Returns PDF binary stream. Set response type to binary in Postman.
